description: This file contains integration tests for the MQTT event publishing mechanism within the Eclipse Hono project. It extends a base test class and implements specific test scenarios such as message expiration and event publication to test MQTT message handling, including TTL enforcement and message properties.

classes.name: EventMqttIT
classes.description: Integration test class for MQTT event publishing, extending MqttPublishTestBase and providing specific tests for message expiration and property assertions.

methods.name: send
methods.description: Sends an MQTT message with specified tenant and device IDs, payload, and topic type (short or full). Handles publish attempt via callback.

methods.name: createConsumer
methods.description: Creates a message consumer for a given tenant that executes a provided message handler.

methods.name: assertAdditionalMessageProperties
methods.description: Asserts that MQTT messages have the 'durable' property set to true.

methods.name: testMessagesExpire
methods.description: Test that verifies messages with a TTL expire after the specified duration, ensuring they are not delivered post-expiry.
